text.tspan: Specifically, the 'Registration Data' tab is clicked
Orval used to generate typesafe request wrappers
The Servlet + Jackson Serialization step is omitted for simplicity.
The full event flow is in our diagram for GUI-2: Display State
Calls into our custom ORM solution, performing row mapping
Each bubble location is set from the server response
dictionary, and each bubble is styled using Leaflet
The political party with the most registered voters is determined from the
server response object, and each bubble's color is set accordingly
